diffs.diff: distance_cm: datasheet reading gives 1 per count, the part's model has none
diffs.evidence: TF-Luna user manual (REV 01/04/2024), Appendix I Serial Port Output Format: '1. 9-byte/cm (Default) ... Byte 0 0x59, 1 0x59, 2 Dist_L, 3 Dist_H, 4 Amp_L, 5 Amp_H, 6 Temp_L, 7 Temp_H, 8 Check_sum. Dist: cm'; spec table: 'Measurement unit cm (Default)', 'Range resolution 1cm'. So distance = raw x 1 + 0 cm, which is exactly what the model already uses: sim.uartStream bytes 2-3 are {control:'value', bits:16, scale:1, littleEndian:true} (no offset), and the driver returns dist = buf[2] | (buf[3] << 8) in cm. The gate reports 'none' only because its conversion extractor reads sim.measure/measures/responses/analog fields and not sim.uartStream; the model's conversion agrees with the second reading (scale 1, offset 0).
